tasks.title: Refactor asset-registry.js to load both manifests and expose a merged map
tasks.description: Rework the runtime loader so a single call fetches both `/assets/registry.json` AND `/modules/registry.json` in parallel and merges them into one id-keyed map. The merged map carries each entry as-is (asset entries keep their `file` field, module entries keep their `path` field — the renderer dispatches on `type` and reads whichever field is present). Update the public surface: `loadRegistry()` (no args, or accepts `{assetsUrl, modulesUrl}`) returns the merged map; `resolveAsset(id)` keeps its name and continues returning whatever entry matches by id (asset or module — the renderer does the right thing with it); `getRegistry()` returns the merged map. On fetch error for either manifest, log and continue with whatever loaded — don't fail closed. Keep id collisions impossible at the data level (assets and modules have disjoint id namespaces by spec); if a collision occurs, last-write-wins with a console.warn.

The renderers that handle asset-type layers — `media.js` (video element), `glyph-group.js` (SVG fetch + foreign children), and `audio.js` (JS module loader) — must read `entry.file` instead of `entry.path`. The two module renderers (`css-effect.js`, `component.js`) keep reading `entry.path` since the module registry retains that field name. task_groups.objective: Centralize the canonical asset-type rules (mime/extension allowlists, mime→type pre-fill, slugify) in one TypeScript module that both the API routes and the upload page import.

tasks.title: Create src/lib/asset-types.ts with rules, slugify, and validators
tasks.description: Author a new shared module that owns every asset-type fact this checkpoint needs: the 4 canonical types, their extension/mime allowlists, a mime→type lookup, a filename→{slug,ext} helper, and a single validateUpload(...) validator. The upload API and the upload page both import from here so they cannot disagree about what's allowed. Slug rules: strip extension, lowercase, replace runs of non-[a-z0-9]+ with '-', trim leading/trailing '-'. Mime allowlist (per spec decision): audio = audio/mpeg, audio/wav, audio/ogg + ext .mp3/.wav/.ogg; image = image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif + ext .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.webp/.gif; video = video/mp4, video/webm + ext .mp4/.webm; glyph = image/svg+xml + ext .svg. Validator returns { ok: true } | { ok: false, error: string } so callers can branch without try/catch.

tasks.title: Create app/api/upload/route.ts (POST handler for asset upload)
tasks.description: Implement POST /api/upload as a Next.js Route Handler. Body is multipart/form-data with two fields: `file` (the binary asset) and `type` (one of the 4 AssetType strings). Flow: parse formData; pull file (instanceof File) and type (string); run validateUpload({type, mime: file.type, filename: file.name}); slugify filename to {slug, ext}; ensure public/assets/{type}/ exists (mkdir recursive); write the file's bytes to apps/scene-engine/public/assets/{type}/{slug}.{ext} (overwrite-allowed); read public/assets/registry.json, set/overwrite registry[slug] = { type, file: '/assets/{type}/{slug}.{ext}' }, write back with 2-space JSON indent + trailing newline (match scene-save style); respond 200 JSON `{ id, type, file }`. Errors: missing/invalid file → 400 'No file uploaded'; missing type → 400 'Missing type'; validateUpload failure → 400 with the validator error; any unexpected exception → 500 with the exception message. Use process.cwd() to resolve paths (Next.js dev runs from apps/scene-engine/).
